events.title: SELF-BUILD / A NEW VISUAL ENCOUNTER
events.body: RUN identified persistent visual media as the strongest current lack. Luke, Tyler, Andrew, Joseph, and Chase considered presence, evidence, action, memory, and observation; the visual-synthesis territory is asked to return a concrete visual artifact.

events.title: Practice / Meta-Analysis
